title: Valentine’s Day wish single-page with evasive No button and celebration animation

requirements.summary: Build a single-page Valentine’s Day prompt UI with clear “Yes” and “No/Escape” choices, responsive on desktop and mobile.
acceptanceCriteria: On initial load, the page shows a Valentine’s Day themed prompt with two clear buttons: “Yes” and “No” (or “Escape”).
The experience works on both desktop and mobile screen sizes without layout breaking.

file_operations.description: Create the single-page UI: themed prompt, two primary buttons (Yes + No/Escape), responsive layout container, and state handling for initial vs celebration views.
Create global styles needed for the page layout (full-viewport centering, safe mobile sizing), and baseline Valentine-themed typography defaults (English text only).
Ensure the document title/metadata aligns with the single-page Valentine wish experience (keep language English).

requirements.summary: Implement evasive movement for the “No/Escape” button within a visible container for both mouse and touch.
acceptanceCriteria: Attempting to click/tap “No/Escape” causes it to move to a different position within the bounds of the main content area.
The button never moves off-screen or becomes unreachable due to overflow.
The evasive behavior works with both mouse and touch interactions.

file_operations.description: Add a reusable hook that computes a new in-bounds position for the No/Escape button based on container/button measurements and triggers movement on pointer/touch interactions.
Wire the evasive behavior into the No/Escape button using the container/button refs and pointer/touch handlers; ensure the button stays within visible bounds and remains reachable.
Add any required positioning utilities (e.g., relative container + absolutely positioned evasive button) and overflow-safe rules so the evasive button cannot be clipped or move off-screen.

requirements.summary: On “Yes”, transition to a final celebration state with fireworks/crackers + sparkles animation and a Valentine message, preventing repeated triggers.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking “Yes” triggers a visible celebratory animation effect (fireworks/crackers + sparkles) lasting at least ~2 seconds.
After clicking “Yes”, a Valentine’s Day message is shown prominently on the page.
The “Yes” action cannot be accidentally re-triggered repeatedly; the UI should either disable the buttons or switch to a final state.

file_operations.description: Implement the “Yes” click transition into a final celebration state; disable/hide interaction controls after activation; render the final Valentine’s message prominently.
Create a celebration overlay component that renders the fireworks/crackers and sparkles visuals and controls an animation duration of ~2+ seconds (then remains in a final composed state).
Add CSS keyframes/classes to animate the fireworks/crackers burst and sparkles overlay (ensure the visible effect lasts ~2 seconds minimum and works across screen sizes).

requirements.summary: Add a centralized configuration file for branding/site title and final Valentine’s message text.
acceptanceCriteria: There is one central place to change the displayed site name/title.
There is one central place to change the final Valentine’s Day message text.
Changing those values updates the UI on refresh without further code changes.

file_operations.description: Create a single source of truth for branding text (site name/title) and the final Valentine’s Day message used by the UI.
Read and display the site name/title and final Valentine’s Day message from frontend/src/config/valentineConfig.ts (no hard-coded duplicates).
Align the static document <title> with the configurable site name (where feasible without changing immutable entry files).

requirements.summary: Apply a cohesive Valentine’s Day visual theme across prompt, evasive interaction, and celebration states; avoid blue/purple dominance.
acceptanceCriteria: The UI has a consistent Valentine’s Day aesthetic (e.g., warm/pink/red/cream palette, romantic typography choices, cohesive layout).
The same theme is maintained across initial and post-“Yes” celebration states.
No primary theme relies on blue/purple as the dominant palette.

file_operations.description: Define theme CSS variables and global styles for a warm/pink/red/cream palette, consistent typography, spacing, and button styling; ensure it applies across both initial and celebration states (avoid blue/purple as dominant colors).
Apply the theme consistently in both UI states (prompt + celebration), including button variants, spacing, and readable contrast on top of the background illustration.
Extend Tailwind theme tokens (via CSS variable mapping) to support the Valentine palette and consistent component styling while avoiding blue/purple as dominant theme colors.

requirements.summary: Add required generated static images under frontend/public/assets/generated and render them in the UI (no backend usage).
acceptanceCriteria: All required images listed in imageRequirements.required exist in frontend/public/assets/generated.
The UI references these images as static assets and they display correctly in the browser.
No backend code is used to fetch/serve these images.

file_operations.description: Add the generated romantic heart-themed background illustration as a static asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/valentine-bg.dim_1920x1080.png.
Add the generated fireworks/crackers burst illustration as a static asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/fireworks-burst.dim_1024x1024.png.
Add the generated sparkles particle overlay illustration as a static asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/sparkles-overlay.dim_1024x1024.png.

Render frontend/public/assets/generated/valentine-bg.dim_1920x1080.png as part of the page visual design, and wire the celebration UI to display the fireworks and sparkles assets via the CelebrationOverlay (no backend fetching).

Reference and render frontend/public/assets/generated/fireworks-burst.dim_1024x1024.png and frontend/public/assets/generated/sparkles-overlay.dim_1024x1024.png as layered visuals used by the celebration animation (static assets only).
